prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Charlotte. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Quick question before I list places: are you looking to use UV tanning beds (indoor sunbeds) or get a spray tan (airbrush / booth)? And what area of Charlotte are you near (Uptown, South End, Ballantyne, University area, etc.)? That’ll let me give the best specific salons nearby.

If you want to start calling places right away, here are reliable options to contact and why each is worth calling — plus what to ask when you call.

Recommended salons/chains to call
- Palm Beach Tan (multiple Charlotte locations)
  - Why call: Large, well-established chain; many locations and long hours; offers a variety of bed types (standard and high-pressure), starter packages and memberships; many locations also offer spray tan and red-light options. Good if you want variety and predictable pricing.
- Sun Tan City (Charlotte locations)
  - Why call: Another national chain with modern equipment and membership plans. Often has new high-pressure beds and packages for first-timers; staff can explain skin-type recommendations and session lengths.
- Planet Beach / Planet Beach Spa (if there’s a local franchise)
  - Why call: Automated spa concept — in addition to tanning they often offer spray tanning, facial/skin services and maintenance packages. Good choice if you want a spa-like experience or combined services.
- Local spray-tan specialists (search “spray tan Charlotte” / “airbrush tan Charlotte”)
  - Why call: Independent spray-tan studios or mobile spray-tan techs often give more natural, customized results than quick booths. Look for specialists who use DHA-based solutions and show before/after photos/reviews.
- A local independent tanning salon near you (Google “tanning salon” + your neighborhood)
  - Why call: Independent salons sometimes have newer equipment, smaller crowds, personalized service and better first-timer attention. Read recent Google/Yelp reviews before booking.

What to ask when you call
- Do you offer UV tanning beds, spray tans, or both? Which do you recommend for first-timers?
- What types of beds do you have (stand-up/lay-down, high-pressure, low-pressure)? Which bed is best for my skin type?
- Do you provide a skin consultation and initial test session? Any starter specials or first-time packages?
- How long is a session, and how often should I come between sessions?
- What are prices, membership options, and cancellation/no-show policies?
- How do you clean/sanitize beds between clients? Are staff trained/licensed for spray tans?
- Do you require or recommend any pre- or post-tan products (pre-tan exfoliation, post-tan moisturizers)?
- For spray tans: can I see photos of previous work and what solution do you use (DHA, organic, bronzer)?

If you tell me which neighborhood you’re in and whether you want UV or spray, I’ll give 3–5 specific nearby salons with addresses/phone numbers and a recommended first appointment for you.
